data.name: Aarti
data.gender_notes: Aarti is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: A ritual of light; worship with lamps
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit ārati, the ritual of waving lamps before a deity. Its root is Sanskrit ā + ṛt. A Hindu devotional ritual. Aarti is a Sanskrit name meaning “A ritual of light; worship with lamps”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aarti expresses “A ritual of light; worship with lamps”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit ārati, the ritual of waving lamps before a deity.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aarti total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
